problems.reason: The page lists Kaiwhekea as an aristonectine plesiosaur (7), then places it in the family Elasmosauridae (9), and later says it was transferred to Leptocleididae in 2010 (10) – conflicting taxonomic assignments for the same genus.

notes: - contradiction: "Kaiwhekea has been classified as an aristonectine plesiosaur closely related to Aristonectes." / "Kaiwhekea is classified within the family Elasmosauridae." / "In 2010, Kaiwhekea was transferred to the family Leptocleididae, but recent analyses do not support this placement.": The page lists Kaiwhekea as an aristonectine plesiosaur (7), then places it in the family Elasmosauridae (9), and later says it was transferred to Leptocleididae in 2010 (10) – conflicting taxonomic assignments for the same genus.
